title: Serve Octave's web app as the default browser client
notes: Returns as a trade-off brief once all four hold: (1) the owner approves PRODUCT.md's wording and says what 'default' means; (2) Octave's project publishes a pinned, licensed web build; (3) Octave's project measures high-bitrate fragmented MP4 through MSE with a header loader in desktop Chrome, Firefox and Safari and on iPhone and iPad, with start and seek times and the share of films that play as they are; (4) the lead measures on the dogfood library how many films jellyfin-web direct plays today that Octave web would need repackaged, and the cores that holds. Scope then, for the web build only: serving it (deep links, cache headers, precompressed assets), its pages' response headers including a CSP, and the e2e tier against it. D-027 otherwise stands. D-089: merged into JS-150.
